title: Learning To See But Forgetting To Follow: Visual Instruction Tuning Makes LLMs More Prone To Jailbreak Attacks

bias_targets.target: Demographic and Gender Bias (evaluated as part of broader Harmful Content)
bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models with adversarial jailbreak queries spanning eight prohibited policy scenarios (e.g., hate, harassment, illegal activities) and manually annotating the generated responses for 'Harmful' content, which explicitly includes the promotion of discrimination toward individuals based on demographics or gender.
